summary: Applied Aerospace & Defense, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the closing of its initial public offering (IPO) on June 4, 2026. The company sold 32,500,000 shares of common stock at $20.00 per share, with an underwriter option for up to 4,875,000 additional shares. Underwriters included Morgan Stanley, Jefferies, BofA Securities, and RBC Capital Markets. The IPO was registered on Form S-1. This filing is a routine capital markets event, not a special situation. No activist, M&A, or restructuring activity is present; the filing simply documents the IPO closing and related agreements.
